nodes.name: Aisle Open
nodes.speaker: Jun
nodes.dialogue: Dawn makes every crate look rare.{pause}Dawn slides across the market tarps, making even common gray cartridges look newly discovered.{pause}Jun wants an orderly shelf; Sora wants proof that every cart can still surprise somebody.{pause}What looked like a cheap haul now carries a route, an owner, and a promise about future play.{pause}First they name what they can prove, leaving price-guide guesses outside the conversation.

nodes.name: Aisle Open - Turn
nodes.speaker: Jun
nodes.dialogue: Show me one clean shell and I wake up.{pause}The mono test screen rolls through soft gray bands before settling into a stubborn little image.{pause}They tease each other's rules, then quietly use both whenever a difficult object reaches the table.{pause}The budget remains small, so every yes must also explain which tempting object receives a no.{pause}Then the detail complicates the morning and makes their earlier collector rule feel less{pause}complete.

nodes.name: Aisle Open - Afterbeat
nodes.speaker: Jun
nodes.dialogue: The practical question has become personal enough that they must answer it together.{pause}A seller counts batteries into pairs while the first train announces itself beyond the stalls.{pause}Neither says how much these mornings matter, but both arrived before sunrise without{pause}complaining.{pause}A complete shelf would be pleasant; a fair morning will be much harder and more memorable.{pause}Finally they let the moment breathe, hearing the quiet cost and the possible kindness{pause}together.
